functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The login page must clearly indicate its purpose with a descriptive title 'Login' and include visual cues that inform users they need to enter credentials.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Since users are being guided to a login page after registration, they need to immediately recognize its purpose to complete the authentication flow.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The transition from registration to login page must occur automatically within 2 seconds, with a visual indicator of the transition (e.g., progress spinner).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies guidance to the login page, which requires a smooth and clear transition between registration and login states.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The login form must validate input in real-time, providing immediate feedback for incorrect credential formats before submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: As users will be entering credentials, error prevention mechanisms are needed to reduce failed login attempts and improve user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The login page must load completely within 1.5 seconds after registration completion under normal network conditions (>1Mbps).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The guidance to the login page implies a timely transition to maintain user engagement after registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The login page must implement HTTPS with TLS 1.3 or higher to encrypt all credential transmissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves credential entry, requiring protection of sensitive authentication data during transmission.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The login page must include visual indicators of authenticity (e.g., secure connection icon, organization branding) to help users verify they are on the legitimate application page.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users entering credentials need assurance they are on the authentic application page to prevent phishing attacks.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The login page must be available 99.9% of the time to ensure users can access the application after registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies that users should be able to access the login page reliably after registration to complete the authentication process.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must correctly apply new dataset type versions to 100% of existing dataset instances without data corruption or loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires ensuring that dataset instances use new code correctly, which demands high accuracy in version transitions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must apply new dataset type versions to all existing instances within 5 minutes of deployment completion, regardless of the number of instances (up to 10,000).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies timely application of new code to existing instances, requiring efficient processing during deployment.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must maintain a rollback capability that can revert to the previous dataset type version within 2 minutes if critical errors are detected during new version deployment.
identifiedNFRs.justification: When ensuring dataset instances use new code, the system needs mechanisms to handle deployment failures gracefully.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: The system must log all dataset type version transitions with timestamps, affected instance IDs, and version identifiers to enable audit trails and troubleshooting.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves complex version transitions that require detailed logging for analysis and verification of proper deployment.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The system must support backward compatibility for at least one previous major version of dataset types to allow gradual migration of instances.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The requirement to transition dataset instances to new code implies the need for adaptability across different versions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Scalability: The system must maintain consistent performance when applying new dataset type versions regardless of whether there are 10 or 10,000 dataset instances.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires handling version updates across potentially many dataset instances, necessitating scalable implementation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Testability: The system must provide a verification mechanism that confirms all dataset instances are using the correct version after deployment, with detailed reporting of any inconsistencies.
identifiedNFRs.justification: To ensure instances are using new code as specified in the FR, the system needs built-in verification capabilities.
